categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P area label and modifies socket configuration in src/netbase.cpp used for network connections.
categories.rationale: Setting SO_OOBINLINE resolves cross-platform edge cases where unread TCP urgent data repeatedly triggers socket event loops under select(). As the author notes, while this 'would not prevent progress nor lead to a crash anymore after #36665, but it's still undesirable' to leave connections in a strange state rather than delivering the data inline and draining or disconnecting.
